test_title: PYST 10: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Town D is to the North of town E. Town F is to the North of town E. Town C is to the East of town D and town B is to the East of town F. Town B is to the North of town C. What is the position of town D with respect to town F?
solution: According to the information given, 1) Town D is to the North of town E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a3d4d8e7879176a797e7abca535eda9fb6cc2873cdd1fc6d6f9daeaba547951.png] 2) Town F is to the North of town E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6938a5faf6399b2cce35eb32fa6e2b1600e6617b82bb93ff09dc0e7528339c7.png] 3) Town C is to the east of Town D.
